products.name: ResearchRabbit
products.note: Research discovery AI; paper recommendations; collaboration features; academic data

profile_text.body:
ResearchRabbit is a web-based tool designed to assist researchers, students, and academic professionals with literature reviews. The platform allows users to start from a single paper and expand their search by discovering related works, connected authors, and emerging topics. It also generates citation maps and built-in visualizations that show how topics relate to one another and evolve over time.

The company's core AI product, also called ResearchRabbit, falls in the search and research discovery category. It offers paper recommendations, collaboration features, and access to academic data, and the site describes it as capable of saving hours on literature reviews by helping users find related papers, build citation maps, and track research trends. The tool integrates with Zotero, allowing users to incorporate it into existing reference management workflows.

The held facts confirm ResearchRabbit maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org under a single registered product. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server entries are noted in the available data.
